label: Bible Study
prompt: And the _____ was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
verse: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
note: Forty days and nights of rain — the number shows up again with Moses on Sinai and Jesus in the wilderness.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his _____ continually.
verse: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.
note: Sung the day David brought the ark into Jerusalem — seek His face, and keep seeking it, continually.

label: Sunday School
prompt: There is a _____ here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
verse: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
note: The KJV calls him a lad — the boy whose five barley loaves and two small fishes fed five thousand.

label: Deep Water
prompt: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how _____ are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
verse: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
note: After three chapters wrestling with Israel's future, Paul stops arguing and breaks into doxology.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double _____ of thy spirit be upon me.
verse: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.
note: Elisha asked for a 'double portion' — the firstborn son's inheritance share — of Elijah's spirit.
